Hi team — thanks for the context. Proposed technical approach and model selection below. I’ve attached a short model-comparison CSV and an evaluation template with the checks we'll run.

1) Recommended primary model (cost/latency/quality tradeoff)
- Mistral-instruct-7B (quantized 4-bit) hosted on Redwood Dedicated trial pool. Rationale: solid instruction-following for retrieval/rerank prompts, competitive latency at 7B when quantized, and good multilingual base performance when paired with a light translation or prompt engineering for Spanish/French.

2) Fallback model
- Llama-2-13B-chat (fp16) as fallback. Rationale: slightly higher latency/cost but more robust on certain long-tail queries and informal language; good safety/performance profile if we need to switch during load or if primary shows regression on specific query slices.

3) Multilingual strategy
- For Spanish/French, we will: (a) evaluate native performance of the primary model on held-out multilingual samples, (b) if needed, apply lightweight translation + prompt templates for edge cases, and (c) maintain per-language eval dashboards.

4) Evaluation plan / success criteria
- Baseline: run current production signals on a snapshot of logs to compute conversion & precision@10.
- POC: run A/B between baseline and model-driven rerank for a 2-week window (or simulated offline evaluation if preferred).
- Targets: +7% conversion (if achievable in 2 weeks), precision@10 lift relative to baseline, p95 latency < 300ms (goal <250ms).
- Operational: monitoring for error rates, cost per 1M tokens, and model-quality regressions on specific intents.

5) Timeline & owners
- Week 0-1 (setup): SFTP data handoff, Redwood ingestion + baseline eval - Owner: Laura (CS) + Acme data contact.
- Week 1-2 (deploy & tune): deploy primary & fallback models, run internal eval on multilingual samples - Owner: Marissa (SE).
- Week 3-4 (pilot collection): live A/B or simulated eval, gather metrics & reports - Owner: Ben (sales) + Laura (CS).

6) Deliverables
- POC config on Redwood trial environment; monthly rolling eval dashboard; final readout with model recommendations and operational cost estimates.

Attachments: model-comparison-20260304.csv, evaluation-template-20260304.csv
